summary: Iteration 36 — Backend-only verification of the shop-layout live-update contract that the frontend refreshTick / 30s auto-poll fix depends on. ALL 13/13 tests PASS in 5.09s. Verified: (1) GET /api/shop-layout returns 200 with {items, scope, category}, (2) ?scope=category&category=<name> correctly filters — only matching category blocks returned, no leakage across categories, (3) No server-side caching — a new block POSTed by admin is visible on the very next GET with no delay, (4) PATCH active=false immediately excludes the block from public /shop-layout, and toggling back to active=true reappears immediately, (5) PATCH title reflects on next GET, (6) GET /api/products returns 200 flat array with no _id leak, (7) GET /api/products/by-source?source=all&limit=20 returns 200 (source normalises to trending), (8) source=trending&limit=10 also works. Regressions PASS: shop-layout create/patch/reorder/delete, image_fit iter34/35 persistence still holds, vendor product CRUD with serial_number/imei_1/imei_2, /products/master/search still returns 200 with local_hits + m91_hits/deodap_hits. NOTE: The review request refers to '/api/shop-layout/blocks/active' but the actual backend endpoint is '/api/shop-layout' (returns active blocks by default via ?scope=home). The frontend renderer at /app/frontend/src/shop-layout-renderer.tsx:732 calls '/shop-layout' — this is the endpoint the refreshTick auto-poll actually hits, and it is confirmed live-consistent.
critical_code_review_comments: Endpoint naming clarification: review spec mentions '/api/shop-layout/blocks/active' but the actual (and frontend-used) endpoint is '/api/shop-layout' which returns only active blocks by default. Main agent may want to standardise the naming in future docs to avoid confusion.

The /api/products/by-source endpoint silently normalises unknown source values (e.g. 'all') to 'trending' — this works but is undocumented. Consider either validating and 400-ing, or documenting 'all' as an alias.
